title: THEY ONLY LAST A FEW MONTHS
text: THEY ONLY LAST A FEW MONTHS. These are designed to only last a short amount of time so you come back and keep buying more. I have had these hangers for a mere four months and more than half of them have broken because the hook becomes wobbly after you turn it and it falls off. And when it falls off it breaks the neck so you have nothing to put it back into. Hence, The hanger is trash.
